topic: Windows file and directory semantics MoonAliza relies on: open-handle sharing modes on files and directories, whether an open directory handle stops new files being created in it, and whether MoveFileEx/ReplaceFile (and Node fs.rename) replace an existing file atomically
notes: Owning pages named directly, no queries: decompose was run only with --dry-run (a real run would search 3 parts on serpapi + firecrawl-cli, i.e. more than the 3-search budget, and the SerpAPI meter showed 0 left). Budget: at most 8 pages.

U-04: MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING semantics, directories, open targets
